scope: Proposition 8.2 (Component expressions) of the manuscript “Finite Monoid Computations and a Uniform Generalized Star-Height Bound” (preprints/Finite-Monoid-Computations-and-a-Uniform-Generalized-Star-Height-Bound-September-25-2026/Finite-Monoid-Computations-and-a-Uniform-Generalized-Star-Height-Bound-September-25-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 134 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3bf9877aaa27427d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 40. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Every single-episode domain used in the construction, including E, S1, S2, Di, D′ i and the full sets, has height at most one. Every prefix component Px has height zero and every suffix component Qy has height at most one. These are expressions over the original alphabet, including when a standalone suffix’s guessed metadata or origin is false.
